summary: Able View Global Inc., a Cayman holding company with China/Hong Kong operations, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a direct registered offering of 5,830,904 Class B ordinary shares to one institutional purchaser at $0.343 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of roughly $2.0 million, per a Securities Purchase Agreement dated September 16, 2026. The pricing reflects a steep discount to the $0.920 last sale on September 15, 2026. Net proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes. No advisor, board recommendation, premium, or closing date is stated. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and post-deal liquidity.
